description: Studio's default socket table. A new semantic type gets a socket by being
named here -- adding one needs no C++. A module that declares display{}
on its own type schema outranks this table; a type named nowhere falls
through to the trait rules below and then to `unknown`.
Entries take shape (circle | diamond | square | hexagon), fill, outline,
outline_width and size; anything they leave out keeps the `unknown`
entry's value. The `unknown` entry names no colour on purpose: the rim
and the no-claim fill come from the Studio theme, so they follow a
light or dark canvas instead of fixing one. The frame_plan.* ids are the Frame Plan's resource kinds:
the canvas names them itself, because a frame-plan resource carries a
kind rather than a semantic type id.
